test_reset_index_basic: test DataFrame.reset_index() converts the index to a column with default naming
test_reset_index_drop: test DataFrame.reset_index(drop=True) removes the index without adding it as a column
test_reset_index_level: test DataFrame.reset_index(level=[...]) resets specific levels of a MultiIndex
test_reset_index_inplace: test DataFrame.reset_index(inplace=True) modifies the DataFrame in place and returns None
test_reset_index_names: test DataFrame.reset_index(names=[...]) renames the index column(s) in the result
